items.title: Smart Data Capture: The Power of Pre and Post-Triggering
items.summary: In the world of data acquisition, “more data” isn’t always “better data.” If you’ve ever had to sift through hours of a recording just to find the three seconds where a signal actually failed, you know the struggle.
